decisions.decision: Build T-151 end to end now. 1) Read docs/onboarding-v3/analysis/integrations-tantra-api.md. Clone Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2 (branch development) and Usetantra/tantra-mcp into ~/tantra-feedback-work, outside every project repo. 2) Build a local intake service (Claude-written code, no n8n or Make) with one queue table. It takes three inputs: the in-app widget, a public form and a team-channel adapter. Reject any report missing type, brand/workspace, reporter, severity, steps or attachment. 3) Build the triage agent: labels bug or feature, merges duplicates, sets severity, routes to T-152 or T-153. Score it on 30 real reports taken from Usetantra GitHub issues and Adi's session transcripts; target 90% or better. 4) Send acknowledgement and shipped emails only to [email] ('Adi test'). 5) Write the one-page how-to-report guide in Backlinko voice. 6) Put the widget and guide link on a feature branch, open a PR to development and request Bharath's review. Do not merge.
